# Linkbot

> Linkbot is a matching layer a platform embeds in its own pages: one space per market, needs
> and offers as confirmed criteria, a verdict per criterion instead of a score, and an
> introduction only after both sides say yes. Everything described on the site runs on a
> synthetic staging space with synthetic data.

This file is a plain-text summary of the public site for machine readers. It is not a ranking
instruction and makes no claims beyond the pages it links to. The site is in English at the
root and in German, Spanish, Italian and French under /de, /es, /it and /fr; a language whose
translation does not exist yet shows the English page and says so.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Linkbot is; the path from a need to an introduction; the four ways to say
  what you need or offer and where each stands; the rules the server enforces; for platforms
  and for verticals.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): a space, a pack, the four ways to describe, confirming,
  matching with a verdict per criterion, approval and gates by a named operator, both yes, the
  introduction in operator or direct mode, outcomes and deletion, who sees what at each stage,
  five languages, and what works on the staging space today.
- [For platforms](/platforms): the embed (one script, one element), keys and origins, the
  console for the platform's team, the SDK and webhooks, the recipes for plain HTML, Astro,
  Next.js and WordPress.
- [For verticals](/verticals): what a pack holds, the first space (industrial minerals), more
  verticals.
- [Privacy notice](/privacy) and [Imprint](/imprint): in preparation; what is already true of
  this site.

## Status

The form path runs on Geoprocure's synthetic staging space in German and English. Text reading,
the board, watches and webhooks are in the Space API contract and not on staging yet. There is
no demo of the widget on this site until a demo space with synthetic data exists.
